_comment: Gate A15: the research sources whose Yamaha models the adapter's device classes must know. The pattern yields the model family (the letters before the number, RX-V from RX-V6A, HTR from HTR-4065); every family a source names stands in src/lib/device-classes.json or below `excluded` with its reason. Every source measured 2026-10-22.

excluded.FM: no model: the openHAB receiver binding names its tuner presets FM-1 to FM-3 (measured 2026-10-22)
excluded.WCX: no model family: the openHAB MusicCast binding writes WCX-50 for the WXC-50 streaming preamplifier, which ynca-python lists correctly; Yamaha has no WCX line (measured 2026-10-22)
